Hi team —

Quick technical checklist and values we need from FinServ to make PrivateLink work smoothly: 

1) Allowlist / NAT ranges (from FinServ) — fill the fs-ip-allowlist-template.csv with the following example columns: source_cidr, description, associated_nat_ip. We will map these to our health-check and telemetry allowlists.

2) Outbound ports: 443 only (HTTPS) for model requests. No additional inbound ports needed beyond PrivateLink ENI health checks.

3) Health checks and endpoints to allow: 
   - https://hc.rw-inference.redwood.internal/ping (TCP/443, HTTPS)
   - https://metrics.rw-inference.redwood.internal/ready
   - We will provide the exact ENI IPs (usually a small set per region) and update the allowlist 24–48 hours before implementation.

4) SNAT behavior: if FinServ's NAT obscures client source IPs, we will rely on egress NAT mapping for telemetry. For strict IP-based auth, we can accept your NAT ranges; alternatively, we can provision a static egress IP for telemetry via our dedicated egress NAT (requires a Dedicated capacity opt-in).

5) DNS: PrivateLink will use interface endpoints and split-horizon DNS. If you refuse DNS overrides, we can provide explicit A records for the ENIs. Please confirm preference.

6) Test window suggestion: 10/19–10/26 (pilot). Please let Tom know we prefer a 2-hour maintenance window during the first day for connectivity tests and a follow-up 30-min check the next day to validate metrics.

Action items / owners: 
- Tom Hsu (FinServ) — provide completed allowlist CSV and confirm DNS handling by 2026-10-08.
- Marissa Cole (Redwood) — send final PrivateLink ENI IP list and preflight checklist by 2026-10-06 COB.
- Karthik Iyer (Redwood) — validate firewall rules and confirm SNAT options.

If FinServ cannot provide static NATs, we will propose a Dedicated capacity egress IP option (separate quote).
